# Mare Leborgne

> Boutique web design for unique Sydney businesses. Sites made to measure, never from a template.

Mare Leborgne is a boutique web design studio in Sydney, Australia. It designs
and builds websites for small businesses whose character is worth showing:
wine bars, tailors, sailmakers, growers, operators. Founder: Augusto Leborgne.
Tagline: "Sites, sur mesure." — websites, made to measure.

## What the studio does

- Designs and builds bespoke websites, one business at a time.
- No templates, no page builders, no purchased theme reskinned.
- Typography, palette and wording chosen for the individual business.
- Sites are handed over with the domain, hosting, files and logins in the
  client's own name, plus a walkthrough so they can edit their own content.

## How it works

- Measured: a conversation first, in person where possible.
- Cut by hand: everything written and built for one business only.
- Finished to last: quick on every device, and simple enough to maintain.

## How a project begins

- A conversation first, in person where possible. Nothing is committed at
  that stage.
- The studio takes on only a small number of sites at a time, so some
  enquiries end in a recommendation elsewhere. This is never about the size
  of the business.
- Pricing is not published. Enquire and it is discussed directly.

## Where

Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. Serves Sydney and greater New South Wales.
